newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 29.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
A front-page commentary urges the construction of Communist Party grassroots organisations in rural areas.
Premier Li Peng says China's economy will maintain healthy development for the next 15 years.
Official figures show foreign trade in China's southern province of Guangdong was up a year-on-year 0.6 percent in January-September to $76.12 billion

Central bank governor Dai Xianglong says China is not ready to scrap its bank lending quota system but may reduce bank reserve ratios in the future. Dai forecasts retail price inflation to be below 6.6 percent this year. Dai also says the next step in financial reform is to let foreign banks conduct renminbi business, but gives no timetable.
